reading.body:
Richmond 2 is a planned 85-acre campus in Sandston, Virginia with five buildings and 180 MW of total capacity announced by the operator, though the campus is not yet fully operating and no portion is recorded in this site's critical IT power figures. The planned 180 MW, if deployed at typical AI training density of 40 kW per rack, would support roughly 4,500 racks, though this is the operator's announced target and not current operational capacity. Certifications and current tenant load are not published.

Virginia has 326 mapped facilities and 23 with published power figures totaling 1,375 MW. This campus, when fully built, would rank 24th by announced capacity in the state, just below the threshold of the published capacity figures this site has mapped. The state context shows most facilities do not publish specifications, so the final ranking of this campus depends on which others choose to disclose their capacity.

Richmond 2 is one of two campuses this operator is developing in the Richmond market under the name QTS Realty Trust, the formal name of Quality Technology Services. Until buildings come online and are confirmed operational, the campus remains a planned facility rather than a functioning source of AI compute supply.
